blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — An Asian Games medal remained elusive for the Philippine national triathlon team, finishing way out of the podium in Aichi-Nagoya 2026 races on Sunday. Raven Alcoseba emerged as the best bet of the Philippines in the women’s individual triathlon, finishing ninth with a time of 1:00:07. She rose from her 16th-place finish in the 2022 Hangzhou edition three years ago. Kim Mangrobang, 13th in the previous Asian Games, placed 20th this year, clocking 1:07:23.
